# python-vlc 3.0.21203

`vlc.py` is the unmodified LGPL-2.1-or-later Python binding distributed by python-vlc 3.0.21203. Its license is in `docs/licenses/python-vlc/COPYING`.

The release package places this file at `python-vlc/vlc.py` beside the executable instead of freezing it into the PyInstaller archive. This keeps the binding replaceable. SHA-256: `1aa1bf54f96ac3f335cafc6672f6474590d6bcee5903b04eea81df828841fc9`.
